svg.text: Left: Standard 6-Layer Functional Stack | Right: Enterprise Architecture Stack (EEA Reference Model)

g.text: • Client DApps, Web3 Frameworks (React, Web3.js, ethers.js)
• Wallets (MetaMask, Ledger), Block Explorers (Etherscan), Analytics Dashboards
Role: User interaction, transaction generation, and smart contract invocation.
• Smart Contracts (Solidity, Vyper, Rust), Chaincode (Go, Java)
• Virtual Machines: Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), eWASM, Docker Sandboxes
Role: Deterministic business logic execution and decentralized state mutation.
• Economic Cryptoeconomics: Block Rewards (Coinbase subsidy) + Gas Fees
• Tokenomics: Staking yield, penalty slashing, EIP-1559 base fee burning
⚠ Note: Omitted or Zero-Gas in private/consortium networks without tokens.
• Consortium / Enterprise: PBFT, Raft, IBFT 2.0, Tendermint Core
★ 2/3rd Voting Rule: Requires > 2/3 (66.7%) valid participant votes (BFT threshold f < n/3)
Role: Guarantees Byzantine fault-tolerant immutability and global ordering.
• Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Topology, Gossip Broadcasts, Flooding protocols
• Node Discovery: Kademlia DHT, discv4/discv5, TLS/mTLS handshakes
Role: Peer discovery, node authentication, and mempool/block propagation.
• Block Architecture: Block Header (PrevHash, Merkle Root, Nonce, Timestamp)
• Cryptographic Primitives: SHA-256, Keccak-256, ECDSA (secp256k1), Merkle Trees
• Chain Structure: Cryptographic hash pointers forming immutable ledger history
Role: Physical and logical data storage representation across all nodes.
Enterprise Ethereum Alliance Multi-Tier Layered Framework
Smart Contract Tooling: Solidity / Vyper Compiler | Formal Verification & Security Audits
Integration Libs: Web3j, ethers.js, Hyperledger Caliper, Fabric Node SDK
Protects commercial secrecy while enabling auditable public settlement.
■ Yellow Paper Standard (Green): Foundational EVM state execution specs
■ Enterprise Extensions (Purple): Partitioned states, private contracts & consortium peers
Provides node identity whitelisting, firewall-friendly tunneling & payload encryption.
